professional_summary: AI Engineer specializing in agentic AI, LLM application development, and Generative AI systems, building production-grade RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP), and LLM-powered automation using Python, Anthropic Claude, and OpenAI APIs. Experienced across the full AI delivery lifecycle, from data pipelines and retrieval systems to agentic tool integration and scalable API-based deployment for enterprise and product use cases.

responsibilities: Building an onboarding automation platform using LangGraph-based agentic workflows to orchestrate document processing and system integrations across JobDiva, Microsoft Graph API, and MongoDB, reducing manual onboarding effort.
Integrating Microsoft Azure Document Intelligence for automated extraction and validation of onboarding documents, improving data accuracy and processing speed.
Accelerating agentic workflow development using Claude Code and the Anthropic API, enabling rapid iteration on LLM-driven automation.
Mentoring intern engineers building RAG-based document Q&A tools on local LLMs served via Ollama, enabling privacy-preserving, on-prem inference.
Guided an intern-led MCP (Model Context Protocol) server project that let users upload documents and query them through the Claude Desktop app as the MCP client.

Built an LLM-powered document intelligence pipeline using OpenAI, LangChain, and embeddings, enabling semantic deduplication and consolidation across 20–50 unstructured documents and reducing manual review time.
Designed RAG pipelines with FAISS and transformer-based models, improving semantic retrieval accuracy and enabling reliable Q&A over unstructured enterprise data.
Developed FastAPI microservices for document ingestion, chunking, vector search, and LLM inference, enabling scalable reuse of GenAI capabilities across internal teams.
Optimized PySpark transformations and Databricks jobs, improving pipeline reliability and governance using Delta Tables and Unity Catalog.
Designed an AWS-based healthcare data lake (S3) for structured and unstructured medical data, enabling scalable ingestion for downstream ML applications.
Built ETL workflows using Apache Airflow to automate ingestion and preprocessing, reducing manual pipeline maintenance.
Integrated MLflow for experiment tracking and model evaluation, improving reproducibility across ML workflows.

projects.name: TubeRAG Assistant
description: Built an end-to-end RAG pipeline enabling natural-language Q&A over long YouTube videos via automated transcript extraction, chunking, embedding generation, and semantic search, delivered through an MV3 Chrome Extension.
Developed FastAPI services for embedding generation, vector search, and LLM-based answer synthesis, reducing response latency and enabling scalable backend integration.
